mLocKeys.keySummary: Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Galio lunges forward with a mighty blow, Knocking Up for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first champion hit. Other enemies in the way take @PVEDamage@ magic damage.

Galio's dash stops on hitting terrain.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Galio's Attacks have increased attack speed and deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies.

This effect's cooldown is reduced by @ChargeRatePerHit@ seconds when Galio hits an enemy champion or epic monster with an ability, once per cast.

<titleLeft>Colossal Smash</titleLeft><mainText>Galio's next basic attack will deal magic damage in an area.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Galio fires two windblasts that deal <magicDamage>@QMissileDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> each. When the windblasts meet, they combine into a tornado that deals <magicDamage>@PercentSuperQDamageTT@% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over @SuperQDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Percent Health damage deals a max of <magicDamage>@SuperQMonsterMaxDamageTotal@ damage</magicDamage> to jungle monsters.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Galio designates an allied champion's position as his landing spot, granting all allied champions in the area Shield of Durand's passive Shield for @TemporaryWShieldDuration@ seconds. Galio then flies to his landing zone.

When Galio lands, he Knocks Up for @StunDurationOuter@ seconds and deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shield of Durand</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is shielded from Magic Damage</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Galio gains a @TotalPassiveShield@ Magic Shield after not taking damage for @PassiveShieldOOCTimer@ seconds.

Begin Charging: Galio reduces incoming magic damage by @MagicDamageReduction@ and incoming physical damage by @PhysicalDamageReduction@ and Slows himself by @SelfSlowPercent@%.

Release: Galio Taunts enemy champions for between @CCDurationMin@ to @CCDurationMax@ seconds, deals between @MinTotalDamage@ and @MaxTotalDamage@ magic damage, and refreshes the damage reduction for @DRLingerDuration@ seconds. Taunt duration, damage, and range increase with charge time.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shield of Durand</titleLeft><mainText>This unit takes greatly reduced damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
